metadata.title: COBO L1 Windows Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Microsoft Windows endpoints implement the COBO L1 endpoint trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A Microsoft Windows endpoint configured and managed to meet the baseline COBO L1 institutional endpoint trust requirements.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This Windows SSPP inherits all trust requirements from the COBO L1 Endpoint SSPP.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only currently supported Windows 11 releases are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Windows endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Windows endpoint is centrally enrolled and managed (e.g., MDM, device management platform).

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Windows device identity must use TPM-backed private keys and PKI-issued device certificates.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: Windows cryptographic subsystems must operate in FIPS 140-3–compliant mode where applicable.

props.name: secure-boot
props.remarks: UEFI Secure Boot and Windows Secure Boot features must be enabled.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Windows security configuration applies CIS Windows Benchmark Level 1 settings.

props.name: defender-integration
props.remarks: Microsoft Defender components for antivirus, EDR, and exploit protection are enabled.

props.name: posture-and-health-reporting
props.remarks: Windows endpoints continuously report health and compliance posture to Secure Endpoint consumers.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Windows COBO L1 endpoints may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Windows endpoint assurance does not grant automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Windows endpoints must support Secure Endpoint lifecycle workflows including enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how Windows endpoints realize COBO L1 trust requirements through operating system configuration, security features, and centralized management.

control-implementation.remarks: Windows configuration details, Group Policy settings, MDM profiles, and security baselines implement this SSPP and are version-controlled in associated implementation artifacts.
